name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. 163 validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery.
one_liner: A giant toolkit that lets an AI agent actually run real science tasks, from gene analysis to drug-molecule screening, using proper scientific databases.
buyer: Small biotech and academic labs that can't afford a data-science team but need to run standard bioinformatics and chemistry workflows.
business_use_cases: A tiny biotech screens candidate drug molecules overnight by asking an agent, instead of hiring a computational chemist.
A university lab lets grad students query genomic databases in plain English rather than learning ten command-line tools.
A science communicator pulls live pathogen-variant data to produce accurate explainer content.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted 'AI co-scientist' workspace for labs, priced per seat, with these skills preloaded and support included.
Paid, validated skill packs for regulated workflows (clinical, pharma) where correctness must be certified.

steal_this: Pick one painful lab workflow (say ADMET drug screening), wrap it in a dead-simple web form on top of these skills, and charge labs per run.
